title: A Tiny Finch Drinks Blood From Much Bigger Birds

scenes.text: A little finch drinks blood from much bigger birds.
It lives only on Wolf and Darwin, two tiny Galapagos islands.
It perches on a Nazca booby and pecks until it draws blood.
Its beak is longer and pointier than its cousins' beaks, like a tiny scalpel.
Scientists think it began by eating parasites off the boobies. Fresh water there is extremely rare.
Now blood is about a tenth of its diet. A bird that learned to drink blood.

description:
A little finch drinks blood from much bigger birds.
The vampire ground finch lives only on Wolf and Darwin islands in the Galapagos and feeds on the blood of boobies.
Would you have guessed a finch could do this? Comment below.
first_comment: Bonus: the same finch also has a gut microbiome unlike other Darwin's finches. Would you want to see one in person?
